name: pitched_vibrato_warp
title: Transpose, waver, and varispeed a pitched sustain
material: pitched sustained material - winds, bowed strings, vocal drones
description: A pitch-centric chain for material with a coherent harmonic spectrum. repitch transpose shifts the analysis up an octave without changing duration; strange waver imposes a slow spectral vibrato; modify speed then varispeeds an octave DOWN - halving pitch back to the original register while doubling duration - and envel dovetail cleans the edges with fades.
source: Verified end-to-end on an odd-harmonic clarinet proxy in the Phase 5 generalization matrix (tests/test_generalization.py, clarinet chain; docs/generalization-matrix.md).
notes: transpos is in semitones (+12 = octave up); duration is unchanged at this step.
waver's vibfrq range is INPUT-DEPENDENT at both ends (curated finding) - 4 Hz is safe on typical material.
modify speed 2 semitones=-12 doubles duration and halves pitch - the transpose-up/varispeed-down pair is a classic spectral-thickening idiom.
